dreamteamer.title: Protocol
dreamteamer.description: The host protocol the dreamteamer UI speaks to whatever hosts it — the VS Code extension in-process, dt serve and dt web over HTTP: every route with its shapes and errors, the notifications, boot globals and host capabilities in PROTOCOL.md, a contract suite every host runs, and the shared handler that answers it. A library: no collection, no verb.
